short.q: Why avoid a Component 1 theme in the ESA?
short.model: The syllabus says the work must not be the same and candidates should avoid a similar theme, so you show two separate pieces of work.

short.q: What should a final plan include?
short.model: An intention, design drawing, materials list, time plan and back-up plan.

short.q: Describe two strategies for managing the 8 hours.
short.model: Work from a time plan and block in large areas first; step back regularly and simplify if behind.
A personal, coherent final piece that does what you intended and uses visual language deliberately.

short.q: Why test materials before the supervised test?
short.model: New materials can fail and waste hours; supporting studies should show you can control the techniques.
